Rashi on Nedarim 31b:10:1.hebrew: שכל זכיותיו של משה לא עמדו לו - בשעה שנתרשל מן המילה, שנאמר: "ויהי בדרך במלון ויפגשהו ה' ויבקש המיתו" (שמות ד׳:כ״ד):
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:10:1.english: For all of Moses’ merits did not stand by him - at the time when he was negligent regarding circumcision, as it is stated: "And it came to pass on the way at the lodging place, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him" (Exodus 4:24).

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:11:1.hebrew: שדוחה את הנגעים - דכתיב ״וביום השמיני ימול״, ואע"פ שיש שם בהרת — יקוץ:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:11:1.english: That it overrides leprosy - As it is written: "And on the eighth day he shall be circumcised" — even though there is a bright spot [of leprosy] there, he shall cut [it] off.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:11:2.english: For it is written: “Walk before Me and be wholehearted” - And it is written after it: “And I will make My covenant between Me and you.”

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:1:1.hebrew: בזבינא מיצעא - דלא הוי זבינא חריפא ולא זבינא דרמיא על אפיה, לפיכך שוה בשוה לא, דזימנין הוי הנאת מוכר וזימנין הוי הנאת לוקח:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:1:1.english: With an average sale - For it is neither a keen sale nor a sale that is cast upon its face [i.e., sluggish merchandise]; therefore, [a transaction at] equal value [is] not [permitted], for sometimes it is the seller's benefit and sometimes it is the buyer's benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:1:2.english: And [that] of Shmuel - Who said [that] he is liable.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:1:3.hebrew: בזבינא חריפא - דודאי הוי הנאת לוקח, לפיכך כי נאנס בידו חייב אפי' שוה בשוה, דהנאת לוקח היא:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:1:3.english: With a keen sale - For it is certainly the buyer's benefit; therefore, when an unavoidable accident occurs [to the item] in his possession, he is liable even [when priced] at exact value, for it is the buyer's benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:2:1.hebrew: נאנסו בהליכה חייב - (מפני שהוא כנושא שכר) בההיא הנאה דאית ליה שמניחו להוליכו לבית חמיו, גמר ומקני נפשיה:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:2:1.english: [If] an accident occurs [to them] on the way, [he is] liable - (Because he is like a paid bailee.) Because of that benefit that he has — that [the merchant] allows him to bring it to his father-in-law's house — he resolves and obligates himself.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:3:1.english: On the return [trip] [he is] exempt - Because he has no benefit, since they were not accepted.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:4:1.hebrew: ספסירא - מי שלוקח בהמה ע"מ למוכרה לאלתר:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:4:1.english: Safseira [a middleman] - One who takes an animal in order to sell it immediately.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:4:2.hebrew: בחזרה פטור - וה"נ, כי אתניס, בחזרה אתניס, לפטור:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:4:2.english: On the return [trip] he is exempt - And here too, when the accident occurred, it occurred on the return [trip], [so he should be] exempt.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:5:1.hebrew: מי לא מזבין ליה - ובחזירה נמי כנושא שכר הוי:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:5:1.english: Would he not sell it? - And on the return [trip] as well, he is like a paid bailee.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:6:1.english: And he is prohibited [from deriving benefit] from the circumcised of the idolaters - For they are included in [the category of] the uncircumcised.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:7:1.hebrew: ערלי ישראל - בכלל מולים הן, כגון שמתו אחיו מחמת המילה:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:7:1.english: Uncircumcised Jews - They are included among the circumcised, such as [one] whose brothers died on account of circumcision.

Rashi on Nedarim 31b:9:1.hebrew: שחיא דוחה שבת חמורה - דכתיב "וביום השמיני ימול" (ויקרא ט׳:א׳), ואפילו בשבת:
Rashi on Nedarim 31b:9:1.english: That it overrides the strict Shabbat - As it is written: "And on the eighth day [the flesh of his foreskin] shall be circumcised" (Leviticus 9:1 [12:3]) — [meaning] even on Shabbat.

Tosafot on Nedarim 31b:13:1.hebrew: הנה דם הברית אשר כרת וכו' - אע"ג דפשטיה דקרא בהרצאת דמים — בדם שנתן משה באצבעו — משתעי, מ"מ מוקי ליה נמי בדם מילה כשנכנסים לברית, כדאמרינן (כריתות דף ט.): "במה נכנסו אבותינו לברית? במילה וטבילה והרצאת דמים". מצינו דם מילה קרי דם ברית, דכתיב (שמות כ״ד:ח׳): "הנה דם הברית אשר וגו'":
Tosafot on Nedarim 31b:13:1.english: "Behold the blood of the covenant which [the Lord] has made, etc." - Even though the plain meaning of the verse speaks of the acceptance of blood — [specifically,] the blood that Moses applied with his finger — nevertheless, [the Tanna] also applies it to the blood of circumcision when [Israel] enters the covenant, as we say (Keritot 9a): "With what did our forefathers enter the covenant? With circumcision, immersion, and the acceptance of blood." [Thus,] we find [that] the blood of circumcision is called "the blood of the covenant," as it is written (Exodus 24:8): "Behold the blood of the covenant which, etc."

Tosafot on Nedarim 31b:8:1.hebrew: שנכרתו - עליה י"ג בריתות. צא וחשוב: [מואתנה] (את) בריתי ביני וביניך עד בריתי אקים את יצחק (בראשית י״ז:כ״א) — יש י"ג בריתות:
Tosafot on Nedarim 31b:8:1.english: That were sealed - upon it thirteen covenants. Go and count: from "And I will make My covenant between Me and you" until "My covenant I will establish with Isaac" (Genesis 17:21) — there are thirteen covenants.
